correctness.rationale: The regenerative stationary law exists uniquely. The explicitly stated Fourier-polynomial generator recursion yields the first longitudinal, second transverse and mixed raw third moments with strictly positive denominators. Subtraction gives a factored mixed third cumulant. All polynomial coefficients except the linear one have fixed signs making exactly one sign variation, hence one positive simple root. An exact factorization at the thermal quadratic root establishes strict bounds, monotone thermal shift and its limit. A separate exact-rational Cartesian recurrence passed 713 assertions on 100 distinct parameter triples; finite tests are not substituted for the quantified analytic argument.

originality.rationale: The nearest identical trapped complete-reset model is Shee (arXiv:2409.06920): its examined main sections and appendices develop a general polynomial moment method and radial kurtosis but not the mixed transverse third-cumulant sign polynomial, its exactly one positive zero at every thermal strength, or the strict thermal ordering. The Kumar-Sadekar-Basu (arXiv:2008.03294) longitudinal skewness calculation is unconfined; Chaudhuri-Dhar (arXiv:2005.14234) has harmonic confinement without complete resetting. The exact globally classified boundary, not generic generator technology or pointwise moment computability, is the assessed new contribution; implicit general-method coverage remains a qualification.

value.rationale: The mixed third cumulant distinguishes the direction-dependent relation between longitudinal travel and lateral squared spread; marginal skewness and radial excess kurtosis do not determine this correlation. A universal single crossing for every rotational and thermal strength and a strict, bounded thermal shift supply a complete physical phase boundary over a natural two-dimensional active stochastic model. The infinite parameter theorem, sharp athermal scales, and positive-noise limiting threshold are substantive beyond tabulated moments.
